request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Roadhook Brute".

Creative brief
Name: Roadhook Brute
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A close-range controller that uses a heavy hook to pull attention into dangerous lanes.
Body and silhouette: Broad muscular humanoid with a sleeveless coat, bent posture, and a large hook attached to a chain.
Signature features: Oversized shoulder guard, wrapped chain arm, and iron jaw plate.
Palette and materials: Muddy red, leather brown, dark iron, and dirty cream.
Movement personality: Lumbering, threatening, and direct.
Attack concept: Swings the hook overhead before throwing it along a clearly marked line; on retrieval, sparks fire outward from both sides of the chain.
Directional details: The armored shoulder is always the right shoulder.
Avoid: Supernatural butcher monster, grappling attack without telegraph, excessive blood or gore.
